title: Trajectory Gap Fill — Public and Biblical Bridges
purpose: Curated bridge events discovered while auditing the global timeline against the public-theology and dated timeline sources. These events explain transitions between larger roadmap milestones without duplicating the roadmap spine.

events.title: King / King-of-kings language intensifies
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: Tim Dooley is the king of all the kings
events.summary: Public kingship language intensifies immediately after the Axis signal and before the first exact I-am-God instances in the supplied compilation.

events.title: Potato spirituality becomes an outward cultural mission
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Potato of Life, King of Kings, Great Book and Bread-of-Life comparison are directed outward toward culture and society, marking a shift from identity declaration to public religious/cultural programme.

events.title: Father in Heaven explicitly qualified as symbolic and spiritual
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: A public livestreaming-God post explicitly describes Father in Heaven language as symbolic and spiritual, making the project's own qualification visible on the timeline.

events.title: Most Human / mundane God formulation
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: The divine identity is deliberately pulled toward ordinary human life: Most Human God, God of potatoes and mundane life, disguised as Son of Man, Father in Heaven.

events.title: God as center / foundation / accumulated public presence
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Tim Dooley is God, Son Jesus Christ, center, foundation and roughly 100k hours online are joined into one public-presence architecture.

events.title: God on the line / accessible repair role
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: The maximal cosmic identity is paired with accessibility and repair: streaming daily, talking through problems, God on the line, Door/fish language, new heaven and new earth, restoring broken timelines.

events.title: The God declaration is explained as culmination and warning
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: The speaker explicitly explains the intended function of the I-am-God declaration: not for fun, but as a declaration to the world, warning, orientation against false paradigms and culmination of a long spiritual conflict.
